profile.headline: Software Engineer | CCpE | SMM | SEO | Web & Graphic Design | Digital Marketing
profile.summary:
I assist clients to expand their businesses by enhancing their social media presence through social media management and growth tactics,  I persuade viewers by using efficient web design and effective search engine optimization. I raise brand awareness by producing captivating graphics. I plan and carry out strategies that use digital marketing to convert leads into paying clients. I oversee administrative tasks that contribute to a well-run, productive business.  I do everything with a knack for creativity.

Among my primary competencies are network administration and engineering. I also have professional expertise on troubleshooting and configuring CISCO routers, switches, and VLAN. In addition, I have in-depth knowledge on routing protocols like EIGRP, OSPF, OSPFv3, and RIP.

I hold a Master’s degree in Computer Engineering and I am a certified Computer Engineer. I design and build scalable, high-performance solutions across the full technology stack.

I have developed robust full-stack web applications, architected and deployed backend microservices, and engineered production-ready systems that are reliable, secure, and efficient. I specialize in creating intelligent systems by training and deploying machine learning models for helmet detection, stock market prediction, and sentiment analysis. I actively design automation solutions that streamline workflows, eliminate inefficiencies, and optimize business processes. I thrive on turning complex problems into elegant, scalable, and maintainable solutions.

I bring strong analytical thinking, system design expertise, and a results-driven mindset to every project I work on.

positions.title: Web and Graphic Designer
positions.description:
I visualize and create graphics including logos, illustrations, layouts, and photos. I shape the visual aspects of websites, books, magazines, product packaging, exhibitions, and more.

I plan, create and code internet sites and web pages, many of which combine text with sounds, pictures, graphics, and video clips. I am responsible for creating the design and layout of websites or web pages.
